sources.conflict_resolution: The older article's general 18 m bend width is not canonical for 2026. The current official 2026 card's 17.0/16.2 m bend widths take precedence.
sources.reference_note: Published dimensions were supplied as externally verified task input; report generation performs no network access.

assumptions.radius_model_use: 31 m is used as the inner reference-radius approximation; its public measurement convention is not asserted identical to the model convention.
assumptions.turn_width_model_use: 16.6 m is the arithmetic mean of current published 17.0/16.2 m bend widths. It is a modeled proxy, not a published dimension.
assumptions.corner_shape: Both 180-degree logical corners use one symmetric radius and one symmetric 16.6 m width although current published widths differ and the supporting source reports that the second corner changed before 2017.
assumptions.banking: Known missing venue physics; not modeled in PR #39.
